But everything changed after I started training with him.

Along with strength and body shape, he has also significantly improved my flexibility, which has made a huge difference in my daily movements and overall comfort.
Today, I feel stronger, more flexible, more confident, and happier from within. For the first time in years, I can wear normal footwear—and that itself feels like a huge achievement for me.
He guided me not just with workouts but also with a proper diet plan and constant motivation. At times, his guidance felt like lectures—but now I realize their true value. Even though I’ve implemented only 5% of what he has taught me, I can already see a major transformation in my life. I can only imagine what I can achieve if I follow it 100%.

Supercalifragilisticexpialidocious!

Their Personal Trainers need to understand what “Personal” actually means. Having inexperienced trainers with false ego and pathetic attitude is only bringing disrepute to the brand. They themselves need Personal Training I feel😂
Gym is spacious and economical - but the gym should get better, knowledgeable and experienced trainers on board. Charging 12k for 12 sessions isn’t justified when it goes to personal trainers with no knowledge, no follow ups and who are nothing but only money hounds.
Gym should focus less on weekly challenges and create better environment for people who come there to genuinely exercise and pay their hard-earned money for.
Anyone who is evaluating this gym - only go there for their space, nothing else.

featured_reviews.name: Yazdan Zaveri
featured_reviews.review_text:
I’ve had an excellent experience at this gym. The environment is clean, well-maintained, and motivating, with high-quality equipment and a great variety of workout options. The staff is friendly and always willing to help, which makes the gym welcoming for both beginners and experienced members.
And about trainers one of the best female trainers I’ve worked with is Dilnaz. She is highly knowledgeable, professional, and incredibly motivating. She takes the time to understand your goals and designs workouts that are effective, challenging, and safe. Her positive attitude and constant encouragement make every session enjoyable and push you to do better each time. I’ve seen real progress thanks to her guidance and dedication.

featured_reviews.name: Tanvi Humane
featured_reviews.review_text: The Strength Company is an amazing gym with a very motivating and positive environment. The trainers are highly knowledgeable, supportive, and always ready to guide you properly. The equipment is well-maintained, and the gym is clean and organized. It’s a great place for beginners as well as experienced fitness enthusiasts. Ever since joining, I’ve felt more confident, disciplined, and motivated towards my fitness goals. Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: Deepak Karade
featured_reviews.review_text:
Great experience at The Strength Company. Clean setup, solid equipment, and a really motivating vibe.
Big thanks to Jatin, Yash, Akash, and Yashraj—super helpful trainers who genuinely guide and push you right.
Definitely recommend.
